title: Business Reversal Share on Final and Price-Adjusted Returns
content:
Under the Business return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the reversal share of the return the schedule settles is set as follows, from the line's records on Northgate Store and Online Orders (units bought, all returns on the line, any price adjustment on the line) and the earning's entries on the membership ledger:

- **When the units returned on all returns of the line reach the units bought on it**, the reversal share is the earned amount less the Cash already reversed on that earning (the total of the reversal entries already booked against it).
- **When they fall short of the units bought and the line carries a price adjustment**, the reversal share is the earned amount multiplied by the units on this return, divided by the units bought.
- In every other case this rule does not set the reversal share.

**Positive and negative cases (hypothetical line of 6 units, earning 12.00, 6.00 already reversed on an earlier return of 3 units)**

| This return | Price adjustment on the line | Reversal share under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| the last 3 units (6 of 6 returned) | either | 12.00 less 6.00, that is 6.00 |
| 1 unit (4 of 6 returned) | yes | 12.00 multiplied by 1, divided by 6, that is 2.00 |
| 1 unit (4 of 6 returned) | no | not set by this rule |
